title: Underlying Tendencies (1st)

  • 2. Anusayavagga 2. Tendencies

Paṭhamaanusayasutta Underlying Tendencies (1st)

“Sattime, bhikkhave, anusayā. “Mendicants, there are these seven underlying tendencies. Katame satta? What seven? Kāmarāgānusayo, paṭighānusayo, diṭṭhānusayo, vicikicchānusayo, mānānusayo, bhavarāgānusayo, avijjānusayo. The underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, views, doubt, conceit, desire for continued existence, and ignorance. Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta anusayā”ti. These are the seven underlying tendencies.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
